coastersengineered.ponder.linear_motor.t: With a Linear Motor in hand, select the start and end of a track span to fit it to the track
A motor does nothing until a Linear Motor Controller is pointed at the anchorpoint the run starts from
Right-click the controller to build a sequence: Launch up to a speed, Trim down to one, Stop until a redstone signal arrives, or Coast through untouched
Whichever step it is on acts on the cart that arrives, and ends when the cart has cleared the run, so a step can wait out a whole circuit
Acceleration is fixed, so a high target speed needs a long enough run to build up to - and a very heavy cart needs longer still
Switch Forge Energy on in the server config and runs must be powered: the anchorpoint a run starts from takes the charge, and braking pays some back
Sneak-right-click anywhere along the run with a Wrench to remove it
coastersengineered.ponder.linear_motor_c: Controllers relay a linear motor by following a list of steps
First, fit the motor: with a Linear Motor, select the start and end of a track span
Then, right-click the anchorpoint the motor starts from...
...then place the Linear Motor Controller nearby
Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
Each step Launches up to a speed, Trims down to one, Stops the cart until a new Redstone Pulse arrives, or lets it Coast through untouched
A Stop given a number parks the cart that many blocks into the run, so a station stops in the same place every time
Whichever step it is on acts on the cart that arrives, and ends once the cart has cleared the motor
Steps are never timed, so one can wait out a whole circuit before the cart comes back for the next launch
Engineer's Goggles report how the last pass went, including whether it fell short on track or, with Forge Energy switched on in the server config, on power
coastersengineered.ponder.coaster_observ: Showing Cart Speed on a Display
...then attach it to the Coaster Observer to read from
Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
The display will now receive information from the link
Select a point of Coaster Track then place the Observer nearby
The Observer reports the speed of any cart passing over the marker
Speed at Full Signal is the speed that reads as 15, with anything slower scaled below it
It watches with the physics rather than the block tick, so nothing is too fast for it
